rules.description: Applicant must have a valid UK provisional or full driving licence
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a valid UK driving licence to book a theory test. Apply for a provisional licence first.

rules.description: Applicant must have lived in England, Wales or Scotland for at least 185 days in the last 12 months
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have lived in England, Wales or Scotland for at least 185 days in the last 12 months before taking your theory test

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 17 years old for car/motorcycle theory test
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 17 years old to take a car or motorcycle theory test

rules.description: Applicant must not already have a valid theory test pass for this category
rules.reason_if_failed: You already have a valid theory test pass. You can now book your practical driving test.

edge_cases.description: Applicant requires special accommodations due to reading difficulty, health condition or disability
edge_cases.action: Flag during booking. DVSA will arrange appropriate support (extra time, translator, BSL interpreter, etc.)

edge_cases.description: Applicant is upgrading an existing licence category and may not need theory test
edge_cases.action: Check upgrade exemptions list. If exempt (e.g. automatic to manual, A1 to A2 after 2+ years), route to practical test booking instead.

edge_cases.description: Applicant passed theory test more than 2 years ago
edge_cases.action: Theory test pass has expired. Must retake theory test before booking practical test.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is booking for lorry, bus or coach category
edge_cases.action: Different pricing (£26 part 1a, £11 part 1b, £23 part 2) and multi-part test structure applies.
